# Recorded astmerge probe cases (see corpus_test.go). Each case was regenerated from its
# seed by the adversarial probe that exposed the per-spec merge's silent semantic changes:
# a random base of const, var and func declarations, and one or two random edits per side
# (insert, delete, edit, move, split, join, ungroup, group, doc, moveblock, splitout,
# addfunc). sides=single means theirs only adds an unrelated function. from= names the
# probe categories the seed was recorded under, against origin/main (out_main) and the
# first per-spec attempt (out_double, out_single). model=commutative cases carry, under
# --- model, the const values and var initialization order that applying the two sides'
# edits in either order produces; model=ambiguous cases have no single expected result.
# "@header" stands for the declarations every probe file starts with.
=== seed=2 sides=double model=ambiguous from=out_double/CLEAN_AMBIG_NOMATCH
--- base
@header

var v1 = rec("v1")

func F1() {}
--- ours
@header

var (
	v1 = rec("v1")
)

func F1() {}
--- theirs
@header

var (
	v1 = rec("v1")
	t11v = rec("t11v")
)

func F1() {}
